headline: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited: News Verification
sum: News Verification — The Exchange has sought clarification from Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Vedanta Aluminium to raise Rs 13,500 crore from Axis, HDFC and ICICI Bank after demerger. The…
